subject: API Security sub-hubs use two different labels for the same back-link: pentest/ and capstone/ say 'API Security Track', event-driven/ and rate-limiting/ say 'API Track Home'. Both now point at ../index.html so it is cosmetic, NOT a broken link. Chris flagged it as a small follow-up when passing the link-target fix, and explicitly agreed not normalising it in that pass was correct scope discipline. Worth doing because the inconsistency is exactly what made my first audit miss 2 of the 4 broken hubs -- I grepped the link TEXT. Pick one label, apply to all four. The other four sub-hubs (auth, cloud-patterns, design, owasp) have no track link at all, so decide whether they should.
